subject: Paths should be within project directory

messages.author: 8cd509597cee391a
messages.subject: Paths should be within project directory
parts:
Hi,

I have a problem publishing my data onto a shiny app.
I put my Rda files in the same directory as my app.R file, and published all of them to the shinyapps.io server.
Problem is, I always get this error:
Paths should be to files within the project directory.

What exactly is the project directory? Isn't it just the same folder as where my shiny app R code is? Thank you.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Paths should be within project directory
parts:
Hi,

Can you send the exact output you are getting? If all your data files are in the same folder as your app.R file, then it's possible the linter is picking up a false positive (which is not un-heard of).

-Andy
